_comment: Brand groups for the Cross-Platform Spread 'same publisher' label. An account joins a group when its normalised name (lower case, letters and digits only; write multi-word keywords with spaces, e.g. "maritime institute of malaysia") CONTAINS a keyword; a keyword starting with = must EQUAL the whole normalised name (use it for short names such as "=aspi" that would otherwise match inside other words). Keep keywords distinctive; the label only hides a row when EVERY account behind it is one publisher. Edit and restart the API.
